title: A cannon protects only through exactly one screen
rationale: Differential partner of mx-chs-002, with the defending black chariot on e5 replaced by a black cannon. A cannon captures only over exactly one screen, and rank 5 between e5 and the capture square is empty, so the cannon defends neither a5 nor b5 and never protects a piece it has a clear line to, including the piece immediately next to it. The chased cannon is unprotected and the chasing side (Red) loses at the third occurrence.
